metadata.name: Multi-Source Intelligence Digest
metadata.description: Real-PI-Agent DAG: extract key themes from multiple inputs, merge into a structured weekly intelligence digest (fan-out / fan-in)

initial_data.value: OpenAI has unveiled a new reasoning model that solves complex mathematics problems step by step. Trained with reinforcement learning, it 'thinks' before answering, cutting hallucinations by roughly 40%. The company plans a phased rollout to all subscribers next month at $20/month, with an API priced per token.

edges.prompt: You are a senior AI-industry analyst. From the article, extract the top 5 key themes and rank them by significance. Output as a numbered list.
Below is an analyst's focus list. Based on it, list the specific questions an analyst should investigate about the OpenAI reasoning-model news. Output as a short bullet list.
Combine the two analysis inputs into one coherent market-intelligence summary. Structure it with headings. Keep it under 250 words.
Restate the original news item in your own words as a one-paragraph reference digest.
Produce a final structured report titled 'Weekly Intelligence Digest'. Combine all inputs into sections: Executive Summary, Key Themes, Business Impact, Risks, Recommendation. Use markdown.
